comparison.objective: Classify six pins with a go/no-go gauge and sort accepted versus rejected pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated pin grasping, pocket alignment, fit probing, and classification-dependent placement.
comparison.success_condition: Every fully fitting pin is seated in a gauge pocket and every non-fitting pin is on the reject pad; fit-force and depth thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: Although it uses small-part alignment, the central tested ability is dimensional fit classification, not controlled notch fracture while preserving a retained coil and recovering debris.
